offline-ai-evaluation.yml.trigger_excerpt:
name: Bounded offline AI evaluation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      phase:
        description: One frozen phase within the retained authorized logical allowance
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [production-authorization, production-teams-exposed, production-teams-focus, production-cov4-controls, production-cov4-population, production-cov4-replay, production-preflight, production-teams-regression, production-teams-population, production-teams-confirmation, production-teams-replay, preflight, teams-sonnet, teams-luna, teams-luna-sonnet-verifier, teams-mini, cov4, stability, replay, round2-sonnet, round2-luna, round2-stability, round2-replay, recovery-sonnet, cov4-sonnet, recovery-replay, scope-repair-sonnet, scope-repair-replay, verification-sonnet, verification-replay]
        default: preflight
      authorize_anthropic_baseline:
        description: Consume the user's one evaluation-only Sonnet baseline authorization; production pause stays intact
        type: boolean
        default: false

        required: true

refresh-opportunities.yml.trigger_excerpt:
name: Funding Finder immutable release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 10 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      stage:
        description: Plan affected work automatically, bounded team maintenance/backfill, or resume exact evidence
        type: choice
        options: [auto, generate, teams, backfill, reuse, validate, publish, verify]
        default: auto
        required: true
      pilot_team_scopes:
        description: Optional comma-separated current scope IDs for the manual qualification pilot (at most five)
        type: string
      qualification_pilot:
        description: Use the existing five-scope/$2 pilot cap and link all LLM charges to the authorized repair task
        type: boolean
        default: false
      final_integration:
        description: Explicitly run the configured Playwright/accessibility suite on this assembled candidate before publication
        type: boolean
        default: false
      candidate_run:
        description: Artifact-owning run ID (required for validate, publish and verify)
        type: string
      candidate_id:
        description: Complete immutable candidate ID (required for resume)
        type: string
      receipt_run:
        description: Run containing the prior validation receipt (optional for validate/publish, required for verify)
        type: string
      publication_run:
        description: Run containing the expected publication checkpoint (required for verify)
        type: string
      publication_attempt:
        description: Exact publication attempt when selecting older retained evidence
        type: string
